I have completed the Market Completeness Audit. I systematically inventoried the sports markets available on Kalshi and Polymarket, and cross-referenced them against the various pages on bainluck.com (Championship Grids, Event Details, League Pages, and Category Pages).

The detailed gap analysis report has been compiled and is attached as `Market_Completeness_Audit.md`.

Key findings include:
- **Excellent Game-Level Depth**: Bain Luck does a fantastic job surfacing Kalshi's game-level markets, showing hundreds of individual player props and score thresholds per game.
- **Missing League Futures**: The NBA league page completely lacks sections for Awards (MVP, ROY, etc.) and Win Totals, despite these being widely available on both Kalshi and Polymarket.
- **Broken Grids**: The championship grids for UCL, NCAAB, NCAAF, and WNCAAB are currently broken ("League Not Found").
- **Data Contamination**: The EPL championship grid is incorrectly pulling in teams from the Egyptian Premier League (e.g., Al Ahly, Zamalek) instead of the English Premier League.
- **Missing Polymarket Data**: Polymarket game-level spreads/totals are missing from event detail pages (only moneyline is shown), and several secondary futures (like EPL 2nd/3rd place) are not surfaced.

Please review the attached report for the full breakdown of coverage, critical gaps, and new market opportunities.

## Championship Grid Deep Audit

Starting the Championship Grid Deep Audit for bainluck.com. I'll systematically audit each playoff grid (NBA, NHL, MLB, Golf), checking structure, team identity, probability quality, source verification, interactivity, and mobile rendering. This is a comprehensive audit that will take some time.

Now performing source verification against Kalshi and Polymarket for spot-check teams across all grids. This will involve visiting both platforms to compare odds.

I have completed the comprehensive cell-by-cell audit of every championship grid on bainluck.com (NBA, NHL, MLB, and Golf). 

The audit covered structure, column sums, monotonicity, source verification against live Kalshi and Polymarket data, and mobile rendering at 375px. 

I've compiled all the findings into the attached `championship_grid_audit_report.md`. 

**Key highlights from the audit:**
- **CRITICAL:** The NHL grid data is severely stale/out of sync with live markets (e.g., Colorado Avalanche shows 44% on Bain Luck vs 25-26% on live markets).
- **CRITICAL:** The NBA grid is missing the "Win Division" column, and the NHL grid is missing the "Make Playoffs" column.
- **WARNING:** The mobile cookie consent banner significantly overlaps and blocks content on all grids at 375px width.
